turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to get my audio setup working on the Radxa Rock 5C. The ReSpeaker mic array isn't being detected by my user account.
That sounds like a permissions issue. Have you checked if your user is in the correct groups?
I just added myself to the plugdev group to enable ReSpeaker access. That seemed to do the trick.
Great, that should grant the necessary device access. Did you also check the kernel modules?
Yes, they're loaded. By the way, it's raining here again. I hope my umbrella makes it through the day.
Fingers crossed for your umbrella. Is there anything else regarding the audio setup?
Nope, all good. Just wanted to note that down so I don't forget why I added that group.
Noted. Glad you got it working.
Lloyd, I'm doing some cleanup on my terminal configs for the Radxa Rock 5C. I'm trying to make it look nicer.
What kind of changes are you making? Colors? Icons?
Yeah, icons. I've aliased the ls command to eza -a --icons=always. It looks so much better now.
That's a popular choice for modern terminals. Did you install eza from the official repo?
Yes, compiled it from source actually. Took about ten minutes. Speaking of which, my coffee maker broke this morning.
Oh no, that's unfortunate. Did you get to order a replacement?
Ordered one, should be here Tuesday. Anyway, just wanted to remember this alias for later.
I'll keep that in mind. Hope the new coffee maker arrives quickly.
